name: Equipment Telemetry Hub
description: Ingests sensor telemetry from connected machines, normalises it and streams it to analytics and predictive maintenance.

name: Service Order Management
hosting: SaaS field service platform with Azure extensions
description: System of record for service requests, work orders, technician scheduling and service history.

name: Field Service Mobile
hosting: Mobile app (iOS/Android) with Azure App Service backend
description: Mobile app used by service technicians to receive work orders, look up parts and report completed work.

name: Spare Parts Catalogue
description: Searchable catalogue of spare parts with compatibility, price and availability.

name: Asset Registry
description: Master data for the installed base: every delivered machine, its configuration, location and owner.

name: Predictive Maintenance Models
description: Machine learning models that score component health and recommend maintenance actions.

name: Customer Portal
hosting: Azure Static Web Apps + API Management
description: Customer-facing portal for equipment overview, asset health and service requests.

name: ERP Core
hosting: On-premises ERP, private connectivity to Azure
description: Enterprise resource planning: finance, procurement, inventory, sales orders and invoicing.

name: Analytics Lakehouse
description: Central analytics platform hosting curated data products and reporting models.

name: Integration Platform
description: Hub for system-to-system integrations: APIs, events and scheduled batch transfers.

name: Product Configurator
description: Configures machine products and options for quotes and produces configured bills of material. Live since June 2026.

name: Remote Diagnostics Agent
hosting: Microsoft Foundry agent behind the AI gateway
description: AI agent that analyses recent telemetry for a reported fault and attaches diagnostic findings to the service order. Pilot with two service regions.

name: Legacy Service Planner
description: Former batch planning tool for technician capacity. Decommissioned in February 2026; replaced by scheduling in Service Order Management.
